title: fix(fields): after a same-edit currency change, a pick's amounts stay and their notes follow the new currency
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Fixes #36412

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户可见变化：在报价、订单、发票里选产品带出价格后，如果在同一次编辑中改了币种，价格不会被改动或清空，下方会说明这笔价格是按哪个币种带入的、记录现在是哪个币种；没带入的价格提示会跟着换成新币种；改成与产品价格相同的币种时，提示保留、价格仍空，并提示重新选取即可带入。
- 为什么做：这是「选产品不跨币种抄价格」那张卡里最后一项（「保留金额并提示」及其 B 方案），替多币种单据的使用者补上改币种后的说明。
- 出错会怎样：只影响价格下方的提示文字，不写入、不清除任何金额；手动输入的金额不显示提示；可以直接撤回这一个合并。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

The ruling item on this card (comment 7118795825, 「保留金额并提示」) and its branch B (comment 7158109013), on both hosts: the line-item grid (`GridFieldWidget`) and the record form (`LookupField` with the declared pairs). Scope is bounded by ADR-0144 D2: new records, records with no saved lines, lines staged in the same edit, and declared pairs on the record's own amounts. Items 1–4 landed in #36918. With this PR the card's last open item is done.

- **Point 1: a currency change in the same edit never changes or clears a filled amount.** Measured first. This already holds on `main` (`057cedfa9b6`): nothing writes an amount when the code changes. The new pins were run against main's source files, and every amount assertion passed there; the only failures were the note lines that come after them (see Tests). Pinned either way, on both hosts. This PR adds no write.
- **Point 2: an amount a pick copied gets a note once the currencies differ.** `judgePickWrites` now records each amount it copies as `CopiedAutofill` (`target`, `source`, `value`, `under`: the code the target was in at the write). The plan gains the optional `copied`, absent when there is none. Each host keeps these beside the withheld values of the same pick. When drawing, it shows "Unit Price was copied as $100.00, but the record is now in EUR. Enter Unit Price in EUR if it should change." only when all of these hold (`copiedAutofillNow`): the field still holds that pick, the target still holds the copied value, and the code the target is in now is known and differs from `under`. A currency change back ends the note.
- **Point 3: a withheld note already shown refreshes to the record's new currency.** `withheldAutofillNow` judges each shown withheld item again with `crossCurrencyRefusal`, using the picked amount's own currency (its `from`) against the target's currency as it is now. The note follows the new code, and its reason too: a code cleared reads "no currency is chosen".
- **Point 4: a hand-typed amount gets no note.** Only a pick records a copied amount, and the note needs the target to still hold the copied value. So an amount typed by hand, or typed over a copied one, says nothing.
- **Branch B.** When the record's currency turns to the picked amount's own, the re-judgement copies nothing. The item takes the new reason `nowSameCurrency`, the note stays and the cell stays empty: "Unit Price was not filled when it was picked. The record is now in USD: pick again to fill $100.00." A pick again fills it (pinned as the control on the record form). When the target still holds an earlier value (`held`), the sentence says to clear the field, then pick again (`lookup.autofillNowSameCurrencyHeld`, round 3).
- "Now" on each host is the same context the pick used, with no picked row. On the grid that is `gridAutofillCurrency` on the current line, with `columnCurrencies` (a header-following line) or `columnFields` (the line's own code). On the record form it is `currencyFor` on the live record, followed parent included. So a code written later in the edit is read exactly as a pick would read it.
- i18n: three sentences, `lookup.autofillNowSameCurrency`, `lookup.autofillNowSameCurrencyHeld` and `lookup.autofillCopiedUnder`, in all 11 packs (zh-Hant generated by `gen:zh-hant`) and in `FIELD_DEFAULTS`.
- One changeset, `.changeset/36412-currency-change-notes.md`: `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/i18n`, both `patch`. The #36918 changeset is left untouched. `@object-ui/plugin-form` changes in its test file only, which is not published.

## Clause-② rework: route (a), `copied` optional

At the seat's rework the first declaration, `Clause-②: no`, did not hold. Route (a) is taken; no route (b), nothing here needs `copied` to be required. `LookupAutofillPlan.copied` is now optional (`copied?: CopiedAutofill[]`). `judgePickWrites` leaves it out when the pick copied no amount under a judged currency, and every in-package reader treats absent as none (`LookupField`'s two `noteWithheld` calls, `GridFieldWidget`'s pick, `planLookupAutofill`'s pass-through). A plan built without `copied` is still a plan, so nothing is narrowed. The published `@object-ui/fields` surface widens:
- new exports `withheldAutofillNow`, `copiedAutofillNow`, `copiedAutofillMessage` and the type `CopiedAutofill`;
- the optional member `LookupAutofillPlan.copied`;
- the `WithheldAutofill.reason` union gains `nowSameCurrency`, so code that switches over every reason gains one case.

The same declaration is in the changeset. `Metadata-protocol: none` stands: no spec key, value or metadata type changes. A pin asserts that a plan which copied no amount carries no `copied`.

Each asserts the exact clear-then-pick-again sentence and that the earlier value stays. The grid branch B pin now ends with the N4 control: a pick again fills 100 and no note remains.

<details><summary>New pins, the point 1 measurement, and ablations</summary>

- `ObjectForm.lookupAutofill-28245.test.tsx`, new describe "a same-edit currency change keeps amounts and says so", 4 tests through `ObjectForm`. (1) A USD quote picks a $100 product. Changed to EUR, it keeps 100 and shows the copied note with its exact text. Control: before the change there is no note, and changing back to USD ends it. (2) A JPY quote's withheld note names GBP and no longer JPY after the code becomes GBP, and the price stays empty. (3) Branch B: a EUR quote's withheld note reads exactly "Unit Price was not filled when it was picked. The record is now in USD: pick again to fill $100.00." once the code becomes USD, and the price stays empty. Control: the pick again fills 100 and no note remains. (4) A typed 55 gets no note through a currency change, and neither does 55 typed over a copied 100.
- `GridField.lookupAutofill-28245.test.tsx`, new describe of the same name, 5 tests. The same four cases through `GridField`, with the header currency handed in as `columnCurrencies` and changed by a rerender, for a product priced in EUR. One more is pure: `withheldAutofillNow` follows the currency now, `nowSameCurrency` applies when it matches, and with no currency known the item is returned unchanged; `copiedAutofillNow` names a differing code only while the target holds the copied value. The #36412 declared-pairs pin now also asserts `copied` (the price is recorded under the code the same pick wrote).
- **Point 1 measured on main's code.** The five source files were restored to `057cedfa9b6` in the tree only, the `-t ruling` pins were run, and the files were restored with `git checkout HEAD` (`git diff HEAD` empty afterwards). Result: 7 failed, 2 passed. The two hand-typed pins passed. Both copied-amount pins failed on the note line after their amount assertion (ObjectForm line 745, GridField line 641): the amount kept its value through the currency change on main. The refresh and branch B pins failed on their note text, and the pure pin failed on the missing export. Point 1 has no implementing line to ablate: nothing writes an amount on a currency change, before or after this PR.
- Ablations on the committed tree with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (`lookupAutofill.ts`; vitest aliases `@object-ui/*` to `src`, so no `dist` sits between mutation and run), `-t ruling`, each restored to the HEAD blob `18535d11faef`:
  - `  if (!now) return item;` becomes `  return item;` (no refresh): Tests 5 failed, 4 passed. Refresh and branch B on both hosts, plus the pure pin.
  - `  return to && to !== item.under ? to : undefined;` becomes `  return undefined;` (no copied note): Tests 3 failed, 6 passed. Copied note on both hosts, plus the pure pin.
  - `  if (!sameValue(current, item.value) || !now) return undefined;` becomes `  if (!now) return undefined;` (a typed-over amount keeps the note): Tests 3 failed, 6 passed. Hand-typed on both hosts, plus the pure pin.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Clause-②: `yes (widening)` (see the rework section above). The diff touches no `packages/spec/**` and no metadata. `git grep` finds `LookupAutofillPlan` only inside `ui/packages/fields`.
- Branch B over a filled target (round 3, the seat's S1): a withheld value that carries `held` (a pick over a target that still holds an earlier value) now gets its own branch B sentence, `lookup.autofillNowSameCurrencyHeld`: "Unit Price was not filled when it was picked and still holds its earlier value. The record is now in USD: clear Unit Price, then pick again to fill $100.00." For a declared pair without `overwrite`, picking the same record again does not replace a value that record did not fill (the spec's overwrite rule), so the sentence says to clear the field first. Re-pick behaviour is unchanged.
- A copied amount whose record's currency becomes unset or unreadable gets no note (no current code to name). Only a known, different code is named, as the ruling's example reads.
- N9 (record-page editor re-renders): not measured. The new work per render is one re-judgement per shown note, and nothing runs when no pick left a note.
